feeds.title: College Fashion
feeds.description: College Fashion is the original and #1 fashion and beauty blog written by college students, for college students. Featuring fashion tips for students, the latest fashion trends, beauty tips, decor ideas, college lifestyle tips, and style advice for 20-somethings, CF is a college woman's daily source for all things fabulous.

feeds.title: Cal Newport Blog
feeds.description: Cal Newport in his blog Study Hack shares weekly posts about technology, productivity, and the quest to live and work deeply in an increasingly distracted world. This site is the online home for the computer science professor and bestselling author Cal Newport. Learn more about Cal and both his general audience and academic writing.

feeds.title: The College Investor Audio Show
feeds.description: The College Investor podcast is a daily audio show that's dedicated to bringing you the best of TheCollegeInvestor.com. We discuss a variety of topics, all relating to millennial money - including student loan debt, investing, earning more money, and more!Robert Farrington, the founder of The College Investor and a Millennial Money Expert, shares how to get out of student loan debt so that you can start investing and building wealth for the future...

feeds.title: College News
feeds.description: Collegenews.com is written by college students and recent graduates, providing the most up-to-date and relevant information concerning college students and young people. Collegenews.com also caters to those looking for entertainment as we provide the most intriguing odd stories from around the world as well as celebrity news.

feeds.title: Every College Girl
feeds.description: Articles on Fashion, Beauty, Campus, Lifestyle, Cooking, and everything else that could feature on a Colege girl's spectrum. Every College Girl is a team of college girls from across North America writing on topics as varied as how to change a tire, how to do a keg-stand and everything in between.

feeds.title: College Cures
feeds.description: College Cures is your guide to life in college and beyond. A resource for advice, tips and solutions to everything you'll encounter when going to college. From parties and hangovers to midterms and studying, we've got you covered. We're your college life advisors.

feeds.title: College Recruiter Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a niche job board for college and university students searching for internships, part-time employment, and seasonal work and recent graduates hunting for entry-level jobs and other career opportunities. College Recruiter is a recruitment platform for several Fortune 1000 Companies who hire at scale.

feeds.title: Your College Sensei - Helping Students Graduate Fast & Debt-Free
feeds.description: Your College Sensei is an independently owned personal educational site. Unlike most other college sites, everything written on this site is based on firsthand experience. Using myself as an example, my objective is to show students how to graduate from college efficiently.

feeds.title: College Life Made Easy
feeds.description: I'm Charlie and I'm one of the co-founders of College Life Made Easy! At College Life Made Easy, my number one goal is to help busy & broke students THRIVE during their college experience.This is a community for college students. Find real-life advice on topics like finance, dorm living, organization, scholarships, and more.
